Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. The company is seeking Mission Software Engineers to own the full software lifecycle for Electronic Warfare products, focusing on development, integration, and deployment of mission-critical software.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain mission-critical software across the EW product stack
Build and improve deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and configuration management systems
Integrate EW systems with the broader Anduril Lattice ecosystem
Debug and resolve issues in production and field-deployed systems
Develop operator-facing tools and interfaces that make complex systems usable in high-stakes environments
Work with embedded software and DSP engineers to bridge the gap between algorithm development and field-deployable software
Participate in field deployments, integration events, and customer engagements
Contribute to a culture of engineering quality through code review, testing, and documentation

Required
1–4 years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent: strong internships, open source contributions, research)
Proficiency in at least one of: Haskell, Rust, C++, Go, or TypeScript
Comfort working in Linux environments
Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, systems concepts
Desire to learn new domains quickly — you'll pick up RF, EW, and defense-specific concepts on the job
Ability to work in a fast-paced, unstructured environment where priorities shift based on mission needs
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance
Willingness to travel up to 30%
Preferred
Experience with Haskell or Rust
Familiarity with Nix/NixOS
Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, or hardware/software integration
Exposure to signal processing, RF systems, or software-defined radio
Experience with containerized deployments or infrastructure-as-code
Experience with distributed systems or networking
Contributions to open source projects in typed functional programming languages
Benefits
Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package.
